1) **Counter badge**: The orange/red circular badge next to the title shows "2" in dark digits — legible but somewhat low contrast; dark digits on red-orange would benefit from white text for better readability.

2) **Text issues**: The "الدفتر" button top-right appears clipped at the left edge of the sidebar; mixed English ("down", "feature flags", "S3-compatible") sits awkwardly with RTL flow but isn't overlapping. The "{07]" bracket notation renders mirrored/reversed — a bidi artifact.

3) **Layout**: Overall coherent — hairline dividers, clean stat columns, well-spaced cards. Minor issues: a stray red square dot near "تعديل", and the bottom "التنبيهات المفتوحة" card is cut off by the viewport edge.
